Name: Map Style
Description: Group containing parameters for the overall style and appearance of the cartographic map, including color, contour, and gradient settings.

Name: Accuracy
Description: Controls the precision of map features such as contours and gradients. Higher values produce more detailed and accurate representations of terrain.

Name: Gradient Style
Description: Specifies the style of gradient used to represent elevation or terrain features on the map.

Flubs.Name: Smooth
Flubs.Description: Applies a continuous, smooth gradient for a natural transition between elevation bands.

Flubs.Name: LargeContours
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes major elevation bands with broad, distinct contour regions.

Flubs.Name: AllContours
Flubs.Description: Displays all contour lines, including minor and major bands, for maximum detail.

Name: Equalize Gradient
Description: Balances the gradient distribution to ensure even representation of elevation changes across the map.

Name: Reverse
Description: Inverts the color or gradient mapping, swapping high and low elevation colors for a different visual effect.

Name: Erode
Description: Applies an erosion effect to the map, softening features and simulating natural terrain wear.

Name: Land
Description: Group containing parameters for land-specific styling, including color palettes and contour settings.

Name: Land Palette
Description: Selects the color palette used for land areas on the map.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Uses a traditional cartographic color scheme for land.

Flubs.Name: Minimal
Flubs.Description: Applies a minimalistic color palette for a clean, modern look.

Flubs.Name: FertileRed
Flubs.Description: Highlights fertile areas with red tones.

Flubs.Name: FertileGreen
Flubs.Description: Highlights fertile areas with green tones.

Flubs.Name: RedBlueSpectrum
Flubs.Description: Uses a spectrum from red to blue to represent elevation or land type.

Flubs.Name: MineralsYellow
Flubs.Description: Emphasizes mineral-rich areas with yellow hues.

Flubs.Name: FertileCool
Flubs.Description: Applies cool tones to fertile regions for a subdued effect.

Flubs.Name: FertileMurky
Flubs.Description: Uses murky, earthy tones to represent fertile land.

Name: Land Contours
Description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines on land areas, highlighting elevation changes.

Name: Land Contour Intenstity
Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of land contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

Name: Land Bias
Description: Applies a bias to the land color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain elevation ranges or features.

Name: Water Palette
Description: Selects the color palette used for water areas on the map.

Flubs.Name: Classic
Flubs.Description: Uses a traditional blue color scheme for water.

Flubs.Name: BlackSea
Flubs.Description: Applies a dark, deep blue palette reminiscent of the Black Sea.

Flubs.Name: Caribbean
Flubs.Description: Uses bright, turquoise tones inspired by Caribbean waters.

Name: Water Contours
Description: Controls the visibility and density of contour lines in water areas, indicating depth or underwater features.

Name: Water Contour Intenstity
Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of water contour lines, making them more or less prominent.

Name: Water Bias
Description: Applies a bias to the water color or contour mapping, shifting emphasis to certain depth ranges or features.

Name: Trim
Description: Removes or crops map features outside a specified boundary, focusing the map on a particular region.

Name: Line Art
Description: Group containing parameters for line art overlays, such as grid lines, boundaries, and contour outlines.

Name: Grid Count
Description: Sets the number of grid divisions overlaid on the map, controlling the density of the grid.

Name: Grid Intenstity
Description: Adjusts the brightness or opacity of the grid lines, making them more or less visible.

Name: Grid Style
Description: Specifies where grid lines are drawn on the map.

Flubs.Name: OverWater
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn only over water areas.

Flubs.Name: OverLand
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn only over land areas.

Flubs.Name: Everywhere
Flubs.Description: Grid lines are drawn over both land and water areas.

Name: Boundary Thickness
Description: Sets the thickness of boundary lines, such as map borders or region outlines.

Name: Contour Thickness
Description: Specifies the thickness of contour lines, affecting their visual prominence.

Name: Grid Thickness
Description: Controls the thickness of grid lines overlaid on the map.
